panels.description:
Non-bug issues per assignee split into To Do, In Progress (open with an In Progress, In Review, In QA, Ready to be Merged or Ready For Deployment label) and Done. An issue with several assignees counts for each; the other panels use the issue's main assignee.
datasource: issue_assignees, issues, issue_labels, board_issues, accounts

targets.rawSql:
-- Issues created in the range per assignee, split into To Do, In Progress and Done, top 20. Bugs are left out, as on GitHub.
-- GitLab issues are only open or closed, so an open issue is In Progress when it has an In Progress, In Review or In QA label.
-- An issue with several assignees counts once for each.
WITH issue_types AS (
  -- GitLab issue type mapping. Almost every GitLab issue has original_type ISSUE, so the type comes from labels,
  -- checked in this order, with original_type (INCIDENT, TASK) as the fallback. Adhoc work carries the Ad-hoc label.
  SELECT i.id,
         CASE
           WHEN SUM(LOWER(il.label_name) IN ('bug', 'minorbug', 'regression issue', 'prod issue', 'qa issues', 'hotfix',
                                             'sentry', 'prod-sentry', 'existing issue', 'data-issue',
                                             'validation-issue', 'logic-issue', 'deployment issues', 'security',
                                             'show-stopper', 'debug')) > 0
             OR i.original_type = 'INCIDENT'                                                      THEN 'Bugs'
           WHEN SUM(LOWER(il.label_name) IN ('tech debt', 'enhancement', 'refinements & improvements',
                                             'ui improvements', 'performance', 'optimization', 'n+1')) > 0 THEN 'Refactoring'
           WHEN SUM(LOWER(il.label_name) IN ('documentation', 'docs-sync')) > 0                   THEN 'Documentation'
           WHEN SUM(LOWER(il.label_name) IN ('r&d', 'r & d', 'research')) > 0                    THEN 'R&D'
           WHEN SUM(LOWER(il.label_name) IN ('team review', 'qa review', 'testcase review')) > 0  THEN 'Reviews'
           WHEN SUM(LOWER(il.label_name) IN ('feature', 'feature request', 'hot feature', 'client request',
                                             'change request', 'unit tests', 'automation', 'e2e-testing', 'chore', 'ideation')) > 0
             OR i.original_type = 'TASK'                                                          THEN 'Tasks'
           ELSE 'Unclassified'
         END                                                    AS category,
         COALESCE(SUM(LOWER(il.label_name) IN ('ad-hoc', 'adhoc')) > 0, 0)  AS adhoc
  FROM issues i
  LEFT JOIN issue_labels il ON il.issue_id = i.id
  WHERE i.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
  GROUP BY i.id, i.original_type
),
issue_owners AS (
  -- an issue's assignees from issue_assignees, or its issues.assignee_id when it has none (NULL when unassigned)
  SELECT ia.issue_id, ia.assignee_id, ia.assignee_name
  FROM issue_assignees ia
  WHERE ia.issue_id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT i.id, CASE WHEN COALESCE(i.assignee_id, '') = '' OR i.assignee_id LIKE 'gitlab:GitlabAccount:%:0' THEN NULL ELSE i.assignee_id END, NULLIF(TRIM(i.assignee_name), '')
  FROM issues i
  WHERE i.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM issue_assignees ia WHERE ia.issue_id = i.id)
)
SELECT COALESCE(REPLACE(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(a.full_name, _utf8mb4 X'E2808B', '')), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(a.user_name), '')), '-', ' '), REPLACE(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(io.assignee_name, _utf8mb4 X'E2808B', '')), ''), '-', ' '), '(unassigned)')                                     AS developer,
       SUM(i.status <> 'DONE' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM issue_labels ilp WHERE ilp.issue_id = i.id AND LOWER(ilp.label_name) IN ('in progress', 'in review', 'in qa', 'ready to be merged (approved)', 'ready for deployment')))                      AS `To Do`,
       SUM(i.status <> 'DONE' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM issue_labels ilp WHERE ilp.issue_id = i.id AND LOWER(ilp.label_name) IN ('in progress', 'in review', 'in qa', 'ready to be merged (approved)', 'ready for deployment')))                          AS `In Progress`,
       SUM(i.status = 'DONE')                                                    AS Done
FROM issues i
JOIN issue_types it    ON it.id = i.id
JOIN issue_owners io   ON io.issue_id = i.id
LEFT JOIN accounts a   ON a.id = io.assignee_id
WHERE i.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
  AND it.category <> 'Bugs'
  AND $__timeFilter(i.created_date)
  AND ((io.assignee_id) IN ( ${developer_id} ) OR ((io.assignee_id) IS NULL AND 'unassigned' IN ( ${developer_id} )))
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM board_issues bi2 JOIN project_mapping pm2 ON pm2.row_id = bi2.board_id AND pm2.`table` = 'boards' WHERE bi2.issue_id = i.id AND bi2.board_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id})) AND pm2.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
GROUP BY developer
ORDER BY (`To Do` + `In Progress` + Done) DESC
LIMIT 20;

panels.title: Issues By Status

panels.description:
Issues currently open per developer.
datasource: issues, accounts, board_issues, project_mapping

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(REPLACE(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(a.full_name, _utf8mb4 X'E2808B', '')), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(a.user_name), '')), '-', ' '), REPLACE(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(i.assignee_name, _utf8mb4 X'E2808B', '')), ''), '-', ' '), '(unassigned)')    AS Developer,
       COUNT(*)                                            AS `Work In Progress`
FROM issues i
LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = CASE WHEN COALESCE(i.assignee_id, '') = '' OR i.assignee_id LIKE 'gitlab:GitlabAccount:%:0' THEN NULL ELSE i.assignee_id END
WHERE i.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
  AND i.status <> 'DONE'
  AND ((CASE WHEN COALESCE(i.assignee_id, '') = '' OR i.assignee_id LIKE 'gitlab:GitlabAccount:%:0' THEN NULL ELSE i.assignee_id END) IN ( ${developer_id} ) OR ((CASE WHEN COALESCE(i.assignee_id, '') = '' OR i.assignee_id LIKE 'gitlab:GitlabAccount:%:0' THEN NULL ELSE i.assignee_id END) IS NULL AND 'unassigned' IN ( ${developer_id} )))
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM board_issues bi2 JOIN project_mapping pm2 ON pm2.row_id = bi2.board_id AND pm2.`table` = 'boards' WHERE bi2.issue_id = i.id AND bi2.board_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id})) AND pm2.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
GROUP BY Developer
ORDER BY `Work In Progress` DESC;

panels.title: Current Work In Progress

panels.description:
Issues closed by the selected developers over time. About 1,100 issues created before 2021 have no resolution date and are left out, and about 1,000 were closed in one bulk clean-up on 2021-09-22.
datasource: issues, board_issues, project_mapping

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroup(i.resolution_date, ${interval})    AS time,
       COUNT(*)                                        AS value
FROM issues i
WHERE i.status = 'DONE'
  AND i.resolution_date IS NOT NULL
  AND i.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
  AND $__timeFilter(i.resolution_date)
  AND ((CASE WHEN COALESCE(i.assignee_id, '') = '' OR i.assignee_id LIKE 'gitlab:GitlabAccount:%:0' THEN NULL ELSE i.assignee_id END) IN ( ${developer_id} ) OR ((CASE WHEN COALESCE(i.assignee_id, '') = '' OR i.assignee_id LIKE 'gitlab:GitlabAccount:%:0' THEN NULL ELSE i.assignee_id END) IS NULL AND 'unassigned' IN ( ${developer_id} )))
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM board_issues bi2 JOIN project_mapping pm2 ON pm2.row_id = bi2.board_id AND pm2.`table` = 'boards' WHERE bi2.issue_id = i.id AND bi2.board_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id})) AND pm2.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time;

panels.title: Issues Closed

panels.description:
Issue types per developer, split into Planned vs Adhoc work. GitLab issues have no sprints, so Adhoc means the Ad-hoc label.
datasource: issues, issue_labels, accounts, board_issues, project_mapping

targets.rawSql:
-- No GitLab issues are in sprints, so Adhoc means the issue has the Ad-hoc label and Planned means it does not.
WITH issue_types AS (
  -- GitLab issue type mapping. Almost every GitLab issue has original_type ISSUE, so the type comes from labels,
  -- checked in this order, with original_type (INCIDENT, TASK) as the fallback. Adhoc work carries the Ad-hoc label.
  SELECT i.id,
         CASE
           WHEN SUM(LOWER(il.label_name) IN ('bug', 'minorbug', 'regression issue', 'prod issue', 'qa issues', 'hotfix',
                                             'sentry', 'prod-sentry', 'existing issue', 'data-issue',
                                             'validation-issue', 'logic-issue', 'deployment issues', 'security',
                                             'show-stopper', 'debug')) > 0
             OR i.original_type = 'INCIDENT'                                                      THEN 'Bugs'
           WHEN SUM(LOWER(il.label_name) IN ('tech debt', 'enhancement', 'refinements & improvements',
                                             'ui improvements', 'performance', 'optimization', 'n+1')) > 0 THEN 'Refactoring'
           WHEN SUM(LOWER(il.label_name) IN ('documentation', 'docs-sync')) > 0                   THEN 'Documentation'
           WHEN SUM(LOWER(il.label_name) IN ('r&d', 'r & d', 'research')) > 0                    THEN 'R&D'
           WHEN SUM(LOWER(il.label_name) IN ('team review', 'qa review', 'testcase review')) > 0  THEN 'Reviews'
           WHEN SUM(LOWER(il.label_name) IN ('feature', 'feature request', 'hot feature', 'client request',
                                             'change request', 'unit tests', 'automation', 'e2e-testing', 'chore', 'ideation')) > 0
             OR i.original_type = 'TASK'                                                          THEN 'Tasks'
           ELSE 'Unclassified'
         END                                                    AS category,
         COALESCE(SUM(LOWER(il.label_name) IN ('ad-hoc', 'adhoc')) > 0, 0)  AS adhoc
  FROM issues i
  LEFT JOIN issue_labels il ON il.issue_id = i.id
  WHERE i.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
  GROUP BY i.id, i.original_type
)
SELECT COALESCE(REPLACE(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(a.full_name, _utf8mb4 X'E2808B', '')), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(a.user_name), '')), '-', ' '), REPLACE(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(i.assignee_name, _utf8mb4 X'E2808B', '')), ''), '-', ' '), '(unassigned)')    AS Developer,
       SUM(it.category = 'Bugs')                           AS Bugs,
       SUM(it.category = 'Documentation')                  AS Documentation,
       SUM(it.category = 'R&D')                            AS `R&D`,
       SUM(it.category = 'Reviews')                        AS Reviews,
       SUM(it.category = 'Refactoring')                    AS Refactoring,
       SUM(it.category = 'Tasks')                          AS Tasks,
       SUM(it.category = 'Unclassified')                   AS Unclassified,
       COUNT(*)                                            AS Total,
       SUM(it.adhoc)                                       AS Adhoc,
       SUM(NOT it.adhoc)                                   AS Planned
FROM issues i
JOIN issue_types it  ON it.id = i.id
LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = CASE WHEN COALESCE(i.assignee_id, '') = '' OR i.assignee_id LIKE 'gitlab:GitlabAccount:%:0' THEN NULL ELSE i.assignee_id END
WHERE i.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
  AND $__timeFilter(i.created_date)
  AND ((CASE WHEN COALESCE(i.assignee_id, '') = '' OR i.assignee_id LIKE 'gitlab:GitlabAccount:%:0' THEN NULL ELSE i.assignee_id END) IN ( ${developer_id} ) OR ((CASE WHEN COALESCE(i.assignee_id, '') = '' OR i.assignee_id LIKE 'gitlab:GitlabAccount:%:0' THEN NULL ELSE i.assignee_id END) IS NULL AND 'unassigned' IN ( ${developer_id} )))
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM board_issues bi2 JOIN project_mapping pm2 ON pm2.row_id = bi2.board_id AND pm2.`table` = 'boards' WHERE bi2.issue_id = i.id AND bi2.board_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id})) AND pm2.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
GROUP BY Developer
ORDER BY Developer ASC;

from user_project_mapping upm 
join project_mapping pm ON upm.project_name = pm.project_name

and upm.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}

FROM project_mapping pm 
JOIN repos r ON r.id = pm.row_id 
WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos' AND pm.row_id like 'gitlab:%'
AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))

FROM project_mapping pm

WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos' AND pm.row_id like 'gitlab:%'

list.definition:
SELECT Name FROM (
  WITH scoped_repos AS (
    SELECT r.id
    FROM repos r
    WHERE r.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
      AND r.deleted = 0
      AND r.id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
                   WHERE pm.row_id  = r.id
                     AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
                     AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
  ),
  scoped_issues AS (
    -- gitlab board ids match repo ids
    SELECT bi.issue_id
    FROM board_issues bi
    WHERE bi.board_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
                   WHERE pm.row_id  = bi.board_id
                     AND pm.`table` = 'boards'
                     AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
  ),
  scoped_accounts AS (
    -- MR authors
    SELECT pr.author_id AS account_id, NULL AS fallback_name, 0 AS assignee
    FROM pull_requests pr
    JOIN scoped_repos sr ON sr.id = pr.base_repo_id
    WHERE pr.author_id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
    UNION
    -- MR reviewers and commenters
    SELECT cmt.account_id, NULL, 0
    FROM pull_request_comments cmt
    JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = cmt.pull_request_id
    JOIN scoped_repos sr  ON sr.id = pr.base_repo_id
    WHERE cmt.account_id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
    UNION
    -- issue assignees, from issue_assignees and issues.assignee_id (the :0 placeholder means unassigned)
    SELECT ia.assignee_id, ia.assignee_name, 1
    FROM issue_assignees ia
    JOIN scoped_issues si ON si.issue_id = ia.issue_id
    WHERE ia.assignee_id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
    UNION
    SELECT i.assignee_id, i.assignee_name, 1
    FROM issues i
    JOIN scoped_issues si ON si.issue_id = i.id
    WHERE i.assignee_id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
      AND i.assignee_id NOT LIKE 'gitlab:GitlabAccount:%:0'
  )
  -- assignees with no account row keep their GitLab username; bots are left out, unless issues are assigned to them
  SELECT CONCAT(COALESCE(REPLACE(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(a.full_name, _utf8mb4 X'E2808B', '')), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(a.user_name), '')), '-', ' '), REPLACE(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(MAX(sa.fallback_name), _utf8mb4 X'E2808B', '')), ''), '-', ' '), sa.account_id), '--', sa.account_id) AS Name
  FROM scoped_accounts sa
  LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = sa.account_id
  GROUP BY sa.account_id, a.full_name, a.user_name
  HAVING MAX(sa.assignee) = 1 OR NOT COALESCE(a.user_name, '') LIKE 'project\_%\_bot\_%'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Unassigned--unassigned'
) all_developers
ORDER BY Name
